summary: An isolated textBoxArea contract linked to Gramlot's production gnr-textboxarea implementation.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.doc: Native textarea row hint; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: cols
parameters.doc: Native textarea column hint; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: placeholder
parameters.doc: Hint shown while the native textarea has no text.

parameters.name: maxlength
parameters.doc: Native maximum length in UTF-16 code units; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: minlength
parameters.doc: Native minimum length; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: readonly
parameters.doc: Make the native editor read-only; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: disabled
parameters.doc: Disable editing; a string also permits ^/= binding.

parameters.name: remainingHint
parameters.doc: Absolute integer or 0..100 percentage threshold for the optional live remaining count; requires maxlength.

integration.binding: Gramlot resolves literal, ^ and = values; native drafts stay local until the updateOn-selected event.

events.name: input
events.role: live draft and optional input write-back

integration.form: The shared form service owns validation, dirty state and persistence; the component exposes its native draft.

lifecycle.connected: Synchronize native textarea attributes, null state, remaining hint and label observer.
lifecycle.disconnected: Disconnect the shared WidgetLabel observer; internal listeners remain owned by the retained shadow tree.

status: Worked example only; this descriptor format is not a frozen public Gramlot API.
